name: Taesung Co.,Ltd.
summary: Taesung Co.,Ltd. develops, manufactures, and sells PCB automation equipment in South Korea and internationally. The company offers 9-axis, 0.06T ultra-thin, 0.05T flexible, high multi-layered rigid, 0.084T thin plate, rigid general, SUS, and rigid 1-axis scrubbers, and one-head and two-head copper powder filtering machines; horizontal wet lines, comprising JET SCRUBBER, DES, HALF ETCHING, SR pre-processing, DESMEAR, and PRE FLUX lines, and wet type unit for thin PCB; vertical wet lines, such as non-contact type developer; and horizontal RTR copper plating lines. It also provides machinery and related services. The company was founded in 2000 and is headquartered in Ansan-si, South Korea.
